link_trace_correction.contract: each of the three compile+link commands uses -Wl,-reproducible followed by -Wl,-t. Exactly one captured stream contains only strict-ASCII LF linker-trace path lines and the other is empty; stdout-only or stderr-only is accepted, but never a mixture,diagnostic or nonpath line. Compiler temporary object spellings are canonical absolute unique .o children of the exact pinned TMPDIR; because clang removes them before return they are validated lexically from the trace and by required postreturn absence,not reopened. Every non-temporary line must be exactly one of: the exact alias or exact resolved terminal path for libc++; the exact alias or exact resolved terminal path for libSystem; the exact frozen libclang_rt.osx archive path; or a member spelling consisting of that exact archive path followed by '(' plus member plus ')'. A member is strict ASCII,nonempty,at most255 bytes,a basename containing no slash,backslash or parenthesis,matches exactly [A-Za-z0-9_.+$-]+ and ends .o. Require each of the three logical roles libc++,libSystem and libclang_rt present at least once; the archive role may be established by an exact archive line or one or more valid member spellings. No other line is accepted. There is no exact-three-line,uniqueness or logical-role order requirement. Alias and resolved terminal identities are descriptor-validated after return; the exact outer archive identity is descriptor-revalidated,while a member pseudo-path is never resolved,statted,opened or hashed as a filesystem path. rc0 is required.
